question: How is the act of rinsing the mouth interpreted in relation to Brahman?
premises: Rinsing the mouth is to be done always.
This act is connected with Brahman.
It is described as having gone upward.
inference: The constant rinsing of the mouth is understood as an upward movement toward Brahman.
uncertainties: The symbolic meaning of ūrddha gatam in this ritual act is interpretive.
plain_english: O beloved, the constant washing of the mouth is that which has gone upward to Brahman.
